answers.q1: They look grounded, not pure guesses: each memo line under 'メモ' carries a name, a timestamp, and a small '出所›' (source) link, which reads as 'this came from something said, and here is where.' But the top quote under the meeting title ('Ken: Windows は次の周で追います。') has no such label at all, so I can't tell if that one is grounded or an AI-picked highlight.
answers.q2: I would click the '出所 ›' text right under a memo item (e.g. next to 'Ken・10:42・出所›') since it's the only element that explicitly promises to show where a claim came from.
answers.q3: Partly. Each memo item shows a name and a time (Ken 10:42, Sarah 14:21), so at a glance yes. But the times don't add up: the recording clock at the top says only 00:02 elapsed, the meeting is titled '17:52 の会議', and the transcript panel on the right only shows entries at 10:30/10:42/10:55 — yet a memo item is timestamped 14:21, which never appears in the visible transcript. That inconsistency makes me doubt whether the 'who/when' is actually reliable.
answers.q4: I would click the blue '直す' (fix) button sitting to the right of each memo item — it's right next to the source link and reads as the obvious 'correct this' action. I don't see any way to edit the transcript itself or the unlabeled top quote, only the memo cards.
answers.q5: Moderately uneasy. The memo items look sourced and fixable, which helps, but the empty 'decided'/'to-do' sections, the unlabeled highlighted quote, and the mismatched timestamps (14:21 item with no matching transcript entry) would make me want to double-check everything before forwarding it.

weaknesses.what: Memo item timestamped 14:21 (Sarah, 'オンボーディングを試作する') has no corresponding entry in the visible transcript (which only shows 10:30-10:55), and the meeting header says 17:52 while the recording clock shows only 00:02 elapsed — the time system doesn't visibly cohere.
weaknesses.fix: Use one consistent time reference (elapsed or wall-clock) everywhere, and make sure every extracted item's timestamp is traceable to a transcript line actually shown or scrollable-to.

weaknesses.what: The pinned quote under the meeting title ('Ken: Windows は次の周で追います。') has no speaker/time label styling like the memo cards do, and no source link, so it's unclear if it's a grounded quote or an AI-chosen highlight.
weaknesses.fix: Give the top quote the same name/time/出所 treatment as memo items, or add a short label explaining why it's surfaced there.

weaknesses.what: '決まったこと' and 'やること' sections are both empty placeholders ('...を待っています…') taking up prominent vertical space with zero content this early in the meeting.
weaknesses.fix: Collapse or visually de-emphasize empty sections until they have content, so the populated 'メモ' section reads as the primary focus.
